newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington up on cash flow, chief exec news.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington up on cash flow, chief exec news.

text.p: Shares in Pilkington Plc rose in brisk trading on Wednesday as the market applauded senior executive changes and bullish news on cash flow, analysts said.
The company said that Roger Leverton was stepping down as chief executive and that Paolo Scaroni would take over the role.
"Scaroni has a reputation as a very effective cost cutter and although Leverton has a scheme in place it's obviously not going fast enough for the company," said one analyst.

A Pilkington spokesman told Reuters, "the issue is that Roger(Leverton) was brought in to manage the cost base, he has taken a lot of cost out of the business and he has refocused the business but he has not done the costs quick enough or deep enough."
The company also said the group's cash flow and borrowing performance was "considerably better than originally projected".
"This is clearly very important for a company which at the top of the cycle has gearing of 60 percent," said the analyst.
